item.title: Samsung Android AT-Command Filter Bypass to system_server Code Execution (CVE-2026-20980)
item.description: Critical severity — binary · CVE-2026-20980 (chained with CVE-2026-20981 and CVE-2026-20982). Status: PoC. Affects: Samsung Android AT-command distribution stack (at_distributor / libpacm_client.so, FacAtFunction system app, ShortcutService). Tags: android, samsung, at-command, privilege-escalation, usb, system-server, exploit-chain, java, apk.
